_doc: THE balance knobs (owned by the bot sim, tools/sim.mjs from M12). The bestiary's formulas (monsters.json baseline) and the item ladders (item-bases.json) were designed separately; these multipliers reconcile them without editing either file. monster.hp/damage multiply every monster; `early` eases the first levels: below `untilLevel`, monster hp and damage are multiplied by `from` rising linearly to 1.
